source_refs.note: Exercise 14.2, Question 9: work done by a constant force (book p.275). Answer 56 Nm agrees with the key (PDF 312).

blocks.prompt: 9. Find the work done, if the point at which the constant force \(\underline{F} = 2\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\) is applied to an object, moves it from \(P_1(2, -3, 1)\) to \(P_2(7, 5, 3)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh work done ka sawal hai: ek constant force hai aur jism seedha ek point se doosre point tak jata hai.
Diya kya hai? Force \(\underline{F}\) aur do points.
Find kya karna hai? Work \(W\), jo ek number hai.
Plan: pehle displacement \(\underline{d} = \underline{P_1P_2}\), phir \(W = \underline{F}\cdot\underline{d}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{F} = 2\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\); point \(P_1(2, -3, 1)\) se \(P_2(7, 5, 3)\) tak jata hai.
Humein find karna hai: work done \(W\).
Tareeqa: Constant force ka work done \(W = \underline{F}\cdot\underline{d}\) hai (14.2.8). Work sirf force ke us hisse se hota hai jo harkat ki simt mein ho, yani \(|\underline{F}|\cos\theta\), aur use faasle se multiply karte hain: \(|\underline{F}|\cos\theta \times |\underline{d}| = \underline{F}\cdot\underline{d}\). Is liye work bas force aur displacement ka dot product hai. \(\underline{d}\) shuru wale point se aakhri point tak ka vector hai (head minus tail).

Displacement nikalein
\[\underline{d} = \underline{P_1P_2} = (7 - 2)\underline{i} + (5 + 3)\underline{j} + (3 - 1)\underline{k}\]
\[= 5\underline{i} + 8\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Displacement 'aakhri point minus pehla point' hota hai, component by component. Ulta minus karein to har sign ulat jayega aur work ka sign bhi ghalat aayega.
Dhyan dein: Minus ka minus plus: \(5 - (-3) = 8\).

Work done
\[W = (2\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} + 3\underline{k})\cdot(5\underline{i} + 8\underline{j} + 2\underline{k})\]
\[= 10 + 40 + 6 = 56\]
Kyun: Matching components ka product: \(2 \times 5 = 10\), \(5 \times 8 = 40\), \(3 \times 2 = 6\), aur jama 56. Work ek scalar hai (sirf number, koi simt nahi), is liye jawab mein \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\) nahi aate. Force newton mein aur faasla metre mein ho to work ki unit Nm (joule) hoti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[|\underline{F}| = \sqrt{38},\ |\underline{d}| = \sqrt{93}\]
\[|\underline{F}||\underline{d}| \approx 59.4 > 56\]
Kyun: \(W = |\underline{F}||\underline{d}|\cos\theta\) aur \(\cos\theta\) 1 se bara nahi ho sakta, is liye work kabhi \(|\underline{F}||\underline{d}|\) se zyada nahi ho sakta. 56 is se thora kam hai, matlab force taqreeban harkat ki simt mein hai. Jawab maqool hai, aur answer key bhi 56 Nm deti hai.
